name: Delta
missing_value_rule: NaN unless both endpoints are finite
activation_semantics: active where the lagged difference is finite and nonzero
expected_invariants: ["constant input is zero after warm-up","linear input has constant delta"]

name: Slope
canonical_semantics: ordinary-least-squares slope over the trailing window including t
window_semantics: window is the full OLS sample length
missing_value_rule: NaN unless the complete trailing window is finite
activation_semantics: active where a complete window has nonzero fitted slope
expected_invariants: ["linear input recovers its per-coordinate slope","constant input is zero"]

name: Acceleration
window_semantics: window is the lag used by both first differences
missing_value_rule: NaN unless all three lag endpoints are finite
activation_semantics: active where the lag-window second difference is finite and nonzero
expected_invariants: ["linear input is zero after warm-up","quadratic input has stable sign"]

name: Persistence
canonical_semantics: fraction of values strictly above threshold in the complete trailing window
window_semantics: window is the occupancy sample length
missing_value_rule: NaN unless the complete trailing window is finite
activation_semantics: continuous occupancy fraction; not an event counter
event_state_assumptions: state is raw x > threshold, never an implicit rolling z-score
expected_invariants: ["bounded in [0,1]","all-active window equals one","all-inactive window equals zero"]

name: Duration
canonical_semantics: length of the current consecutive active run, including t; zero while inactive
window_semantics: window is not used; threshold defines active state
missing_value_rule: NaN resets the run; output is NaN at the missing coordinate
activation_semantics: increments only while x > threshold and resets to zero otherwise
expected_invariants: ["inactive is zero","first active coordinate is one","missing values reset the run"]

name: StateAge
canonical_semantics: age of the current boolean state since its most recent transition; zero on transition
window_semantics: window is not used; threshold defines boolean state
missing_value_rule: NaN resets state identity; output is NaN at the missing coordinate
activation_semantics: tracks both active and inactive state age
event_state_assumptions: raw threshold state; distinct from active-only Duration
expected_invariants: ["zero on each state change","increments while either state persists","missing resets age"]

name: TimeSince
canonical_semantics: elapsed coordinates since the latest rising threshold activation; zero at a hit
output_domain: nonnegative float panel with NaN before first hit
warm_up_rule: NaN until the first rising activation in each finite segment
activation_semantics: increments after a rising activation until the next activation
event_state_assumptions: event is a false-to-true raw-threshold transition
expected_invariants: ["zero at every rising event","increments by one between hits","never equals absolute hit index"]

name: LastHit
canonical_semantics: absolute time-coordinate index of the latest rising threshold activation
output_domain: float coordinate-index panel with NaN before first hit
warm_up_rule: NaN until the first rising activation in each finite segment
activation_semantics: holds the last activation coordinate until the next activation
event_state_assumptions: event is a false-to-true raw-threshold transition
expected_invariants: ["equals coordinate index at a hit","is piecewise constant between hits","is not event age"]

name: FirstHit
canonical_semantics: one-shot pulse at the first rising threshold activation of each finite segment
missing_value_rule: NaN resets the segment; output is NaN at the missing coordinate
activation_semantics: one at only the first activation, zero at later activations in the segment
event_state_assumptions: event is a false-to-true raw-threshold transition
expected_invariants: ["at most one pulse per finite segment","later transitions are not FirstHit"]

name: Transition
canonical_semantics: signed boolean-state change: +1 rising, -1 falling, 0 unchanged
missing_value_rule: NaN resets state; first finite active state is a +1 activation
activation_semantics: reports every state transition, not only the first

name: PathShape
canonical_semantics: mean(last third) - mean(first third) inside the complete trailing window
window_semantics: window is split into non-overlapping first/last thirds and must be >=3
missing_value_rule: NaN unless the complete trailing window is finite
activation_semantics: active where early and late path thirds differ
event_state_assumptions: path geometry; not a short-minus-long moving average
expected_invariants: ["constant path is zero","is distinct from MultiScaleRelation"]

name: EventWindow
canonical_semantics: count of rising threshold activations in the trailing window
window_semantics: window is the event-count lookback including t
warm_up_rule: window-1 coordinates inside each finite segment
missing_value_rule: NaN resets event history; windows never cross a missing coordinate
activation_semantics: counts rising activations, not active-state occupancy or arbitrary value changes
event_state_assumptions: event is a false-to-true raw-threshold transition
expected_invariants: ["singleton event count is one","persistent active state does not create repeated events"]

name: MultiScaleRelation
canonical_semantics: trailing short-window mean minus trailing long-window mean
missing_value_rule: NaN unless both complete windows are finite
activation_semantics: active where short and long path levels differ
expected_invariants: ["constant path is zero","short window must be strictly smaller than long window"]
